title: A spoiler with a mind of its own. Almost.
author: dachi
summary: A look back at the earlier spoiler control electronics: orientation in, servo motion out, and response curves to tune in between.
mediaAlt: The active-spoiler electronics and actuator assembly on the bench.
content:
## Attitude becomes a response curve

The earlier ESP32 sketch calculated roll and pitch from the MPU6050 accelerometer. It interpolated editable curves from one of three presets and combined them into two servo commands. This photograph documents that electronics stage.

The presets used **21 input points**. A browser interface made calibration and response changes visible while iterating.

The project has since moved to **Project Tsintsadze**: two ESP32 boards, four encoder-feedback DC motors, and paired four-bar wing linkages. The linked project page and repository describe the current implementation.
